label: Illustrative rosters
definition: A small, entirely ILLUSTRATIVE roster used to demonstrate roster-fit and matchup queries. Players are fictional; the archetype exemplars attached to archetype nodes in data/positions.json are editorial examples only. No statistics, contracts or scouting grades are asserted.

nodes.label: Harbour
nodes.definition: Illustrative team. Identity: switchable, five-out offence, aggressive ball-screen defence.

nodes.label: Highland
nodes.definition: Illustrative team. Identity: hub-based offence from the elbow, drop coverage at the back.

props.note: Prefers switchable lineups and five-out spacing.
Builds everything around an elbow hub and a drop-coverage anchor.

nodes.label: Andre Vega
nodes.definition: Illustrative primary initiator: runs the majority of the team's ball screens.

nodes.label: Marcus Ide
nodes.definition: Illustrative movement shooter who occupies the corners and relocates on the drive.

nodes.label: Tobias Lund
nodes.definition: Illustrative 3-and-D wing who takes the opponent's best perimeter scorer.

nodes.label: Noah Ayres
nodes.definition: Illustrative stretch four whose shooting is the reason the team can run five-out.

nodes.label: Ibrahim Kaya
nodes.definition: Illustrative anchor who protects the rim and screens; the last line of a switch-everything scheme.

nodes.label: Diego Ferran
nodes.definition: Illustrative shot-making initiator who punishes drop coverage with the pull-up three.

nodes.label: Kwame Osei
nodes.definition: Illustrative secondary creator who runs the second action off the hub.

nodes.label: Luka Berg
nodes.definition: Illustrative slasher who attacks closeouts and forces the collapse that feeds the corner.

nodes.label: Sam Whitlow
nodes.definition: Illustrative switchable forward, the connective defender of the scheme.

nodes.label: Emil Novak
nodes.definition: Illustrative hub big who receives at the elbow and re-distributes; also the drop-coverage anchor.
